name: BPM Finder App
short_description: Calculate audio song tempo (BPM), tap beat intervals, and audio delay note divisions online.
full_description:
BPM Finder App is a professional audio tempo detection tool, interactive tap metronome, and delay/reverb timing calculator built for music producers, DJs, audio engineers, and musicians.

Key Features:
- Audio Tempo Detection: Compute exact song BPM and average beat intervals.
- Tap Tempo Metronome: Tap along to any rhythm using your mouse or Spacebar.
- Delay & Reverb Note Calculator: Instant millisecond calculations for 1/4, 1/8, 1/8d, 1/16, and triplet delay divisions.
- 100% Local Privacy: All audio DSP calculations run locally inside your browser via WebAudio/WASM with zero server uploads.

Visit official web app: https://bpmfinderapp.com
